findings.citation_text: RF-based sensing. In recent years, there has been an increasing amount of literature on contactless sensing using various RF signals including WiFi [36, 45, 57, 62, 63], RFID [52, 53], UWB [72, 73], LoRa [11, 71] and FMCW radar [9, 78] to sense people and objects.
